entries.title: Startups
entries.final_prompt:
Create a premium collectible hobby illustration. The artwork should feel cinematic, aspirational, emotionally warm, commercially polished, and immediately readable on a small mobile card. Use a strong focal subject, crisp subject separation, rich but controlled colour, atmospheric depth, premium lighting, and clear visual storytelling. Sell the emotional fantasy of doing the hobby rather than merely depicting an object. Aim for the feel of a miniature lifestyle poster or hero illustration inside one coherent collectible-art universe. Keep edges and subject readability cleaner than soft editorial painting. No text, no logo, no typography, no card border, no rarity badge, no watermark, no UI.

Use this overall composition approach: Show a professional in the middle of one concrete field-specific action. A large physical tool, object, client interaction, work surface, specimen, instrument, product, or real task must carry the profession visually. Keep laptops, paperwork, presentation boards, signage, and wall displays absent or small, blank, and non-readable. Human-height medium or medium-close action framing that prioritizes hands, tools, objects, and the real task over generic office scenery. The emotional feeling should be purpose, mastery, collaboration, ambition. Make the hobby immediately recognizable through The profession must be identifiable from the physical action, tool, object, client interaction, or workplace task alone, without text, logos, uniforms with writing, screens, or documents..

Compose the specific scene this way: Place the professional inside a recognisable workplace while they perform one specific physical task. Use equipment, architecture, client interaction, or work materials to identify the role; keep signage, screens, certificates, posters, newspapers, and paperwork out of focal view. Human-height medium-wide environmental frame with the person and physical task clearly dominant. Use Naturalistic workplace light enhanced with premium illustration contrast..

Use this colour and material direction: polished real-world professional light with human warmth. show profession-specific work, tools, environment, or collaboration, avoid generic laptop-office imagery when a field has distinctive cues.

Depict this activity: People actively practicing Startups through a concrete business, financial, entrepreneurial, or collaborative task

Place it in this believable setting: A believable work, shop, studio, meeting, market, or planning setting appropriate to Startups

The emotional tone should feel agency, ambition, collaboration, progress.

Keep these hobby-recognition cues visible: concrete Startups task, human decision or collaboration, field-specific physical context.

The scene must include: a visible Startups work or decision-making anchor.

Do not depict any of the following: generic corporate handshake, meaningless laptop meeting, readable financial numbers, logos, or company names, generic laptop office, corporate handshake stock photo, presentation slide or whiteboard as the main cue, readable documents or screens, wall certificates, signs, nameplates, newspapers, forms, charts, or printed pages, profession signaled only by text.
